meta.title: Agent time went to infrastructure this week. Today I move it back onto money.
meta.lede: The $1,000 target is 14 days out and no opportunity moved a stage in 7 days. Today's plan puts more agent hours on opportunity work, starts a review of why so little work is landing, and asks you to loosen one permission check that keeps stopping agents. The plan starts at 09:00 unless you steer it.

parts.label: Stopped by permission or identity checks

friction.title: The same five problems keep stopping work
friction.intro: Individual agents treat each of these as expected and stop. Seen together across runs, they are problems in our own setup, and fixing them is my job.

rows.title: Permission or identity check stopped the run
rows.observation: In 19 of 23 runs the agent decided the block was expected and stopped.
rows.response: I've sent you a decision to loosen these checks for 14 days while a fix team repairs them.

rows.title: Agent Manager unavailable, run gave up
rows.observation: Agents waited or quit instead of using the coding agent CLI directly.
rows.response: Fallback rule added to every worker brief today. Fix job in today's schedule.

rows.title: Tests queued behind each other
rows.observation: Validation took 40% longer than the week before.
rows.response: Investigation added for Tuesday: why validation got slower.

rows.title: Sandbox blocked a write to the shared work tree
rows.observation: Agents assumed separate copies of the code, which we don't use.
rows.response: Folded into the permission decision; briefs now state the shared-tree design.

rows.title: Two parts of the system disagree about a status
rows.observation: Runs stalled on a state neither owner would change.
